startup.error_state: The Bad path writes no Cvars field carrying a permanent write hold and does not dirty Cvars+0xd0. Its different boolean stores are stack cleanup flags only. The existing writer/timer dossier independently binds dirty+0xd0 as persistence gate. Malformed input is not overwritten by boot load itself; a later normal change can dirty and save.

load_file.case_lookup: 0x140e89e98..0x140e8a04e copies each key and lowercases ASCII A-Z; registered-name HashMap lookup follows
load_file.unknown: No registered index:0x140e8a137..0x140e8a1f0 warns using encoded literal0x145a4ef59: config: unknown cvar '{name}' — preserved, not applied; continue to next entry
load_file.session_owned: 0x140e8a1fa..0x140e8a2f2 checks lowercased-name session HashSet; present path0x140e8a4a2 uses literal0x145a4ef14: config: {name} is owned by this session, not the file (file value kept)
load_file.numeric: Row stride0x68; default String ptr+0x20,len+0x28.0x140e8a307..0x140e8a322 trims/parses default; if parse fails string row bypasses numeric rejection. Otherwise0x140e8a324..0x140e8a341 trims/parses saved value, Err bit0 jumps0x140e8a58b warning: config: {name}: unparseable value '{value}' ignored
load_file.unchanged: 0x140e8a34a..0x140e8a385 compares existing applied value length and bytes; equal skips event
load_file.changed: 0x140e8a38b..0x140e8a492 clones saved string into row applied value and queues old/new/name CvarChanged in resource+0x18 vector; no dirty write in this load path
load_file.preservation: After all entries,0x140e8aa59 drops previous retained map and moves whole incoming map into resource+0xb8,+0xc0,+0xc8. Unknown, session-owned and numerically rejected entries therefore remain raw in that retained map. Later writer composition can update/remove known overrides according to actual current/default strings.
load_file.events: Common tail0x140e8a83e takes queued event vector, resets it to empty, triggers each through0x1413a92b0, and drops iterator. Bad/Absent still follow common tail for prior session ownership events.

parser_helpers.trim: 0x14010afd0..0x14010b249: UTF-8 forward/backward codepoint traversal; strips whitespace including ASCII9..13/32 and Unicode checks0x85,0x1680,0x3000/table lookups; returns slice pointerRAX,lengthRDX. It is applied before f32 parse, not stored back to the retained string.
parser_helpers.f32: 0x1456d8bf0..0x1456d90b3: 23-bit mantissa/exponent127, CVTSI2SS/MULSS, optional sign, accepts case-insensitive inf/infinity/nan; returns result error bit0=1. No finite-value test in caller.
